methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a local native in Hampton Roads signals grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, creating pathways for distributed deep learning if sustained beyond individual initiatives.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA represents institutional commitment to community-wide AI education beyond elite university contexts, testing whether metro areas outside NoVA can build distributed capability networks.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab creates a regional center of AI expertise, but concentration at a single institution risks deepening intra-regional gaps unless knowledge diffuses to surrounding rural communities and employers.

signals.title: Virginia Tech secures $20m NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor lab - Cleanroom Technology
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's $20M NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor research reinforces the New River Valley as a technical excellence hub, but capital-intensive infrastructure investments typically concentrate rather than distribute capability.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Radford University grads to hold EV truck company launch event Aug. 20
signals.signal_reading: AI Decoded event featuring a Blacksburg-based marketing studio founder signals practical AI application diffusing into regional business communities, suggesting peer-to-peer knowledge transfer beyond academic institutions.
